data.action: 海边祭典摊位举起捞到的星星面具，半扎发在灯笼与海风里轻摇
data.description: 【夏日祭海滨摊位·傍晚】有希穿着紫白泳装外搭轻薄浴衣短衫，坐在海边祭典的捞面具摊旁挑选纪念品；她把捞到的星星面具举给镜头，半扎发被灯笼和海风照得轻轻摇曳。
data.lighting: lantern glow mixed with blue evening sea light
data.mood: 宅系少女的海滨约会活力
data.promptProse: Yuki sits beside a seaside festival souvenir stall in her violet-and-white swimsuit and short yukata jacket, lifting a star mask she has chosen toward the camera. Her half-up hair shifts with the sea breeze. The horizontal medium view includes the stall basin nearby and the sea behind. Lantern glow warms her sleeve and mask, while blue evening water light cools her hair ribbon and distant horizon.
data.title: 周防有希 · 海滨捞面具的夏日约会
